description: Verify Wave1 produced deepening artifacts per topic: evidence-summary.md, question-list.md, reference/{topic_slug}*.md rich MD reference files per topic, backfill token replacement, trace, and status.

rules.failure_message: Missing directory: artifacts/wave1/. Create the directory and add per-topic evidence-summary.md files.
Missing evidence-summary file: artifacts/wave1/{topic}/evidence-summary.md. Run the deepening task for this topic via the queue-driven batch protocol.
Missing question-list file: artifacts/wave1/{topic}/question-list.md. Every topic must have a paired question-list.md alongside evidence-summary.md.
Topic {topic} has fewer than 1 reference/*{topic}*.md rich MD file. Create at least one topic-slug-prefixed reference file per shared-reference-template.md.
Reference file for {topic} contains placeholder source_url (example.com). Delete the placeholder file and write a real reference or suppl-failure-r{N}.md instead.
Reference files for {topic} must use metadata block format with 9 required fields and the 5 standard sections; YAML frontmatter is not allowed.
Reference files for {topic} must declare a non-empty article-level source_url in metadata block format.
Reference files for {topic} must contain at least 5 concrete bullet facts in ## Key Facts.
Reference files for {topic} must be declared in rb_output_declarations.jsonl via delegated relay/queue completion.

rules.pattern: ## Topic Investigation Targets[\s\S]*## Question Reconciliation[\s\S]*## Emergent Question Protocol[\s\S]*## Exploration\s*/\s*Exploitation Decision
rules.failure_message: question-list.md for {topic} must contain all four sections in order: Topic Investigation Targets, Question Reconciliation, Emergent Question Protocol, Exploration / Exploitation Decision.
evidence-summary.md for {topic} must contain at least 1 source URL in Markdown link format. Sub-agent must do real WebSearch+WebFetch.
evidence-summary.md for {topic} must have a non-empty ## Key Findings section with at least 1 numbered finding.
Stale backfill token __BACKFILL_WAVE1_MECHANISMS__ found in seed_topics/{topic}.md. Replace the token with actual mechanism findings.
Stale backfill token __BACKFILL_WAVE1_TRENDS__ found in seed_topics/{topic}.md. Replace the token with actual trends.
Stale backfill token __BACKFILL_PENDING_QUESTIONS__ found in seed_topics/{topic}.md. Replace with updated question status tags.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'wave1_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct gate value.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'wave2_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct value.
检测到虚假或重复 reference 文件

Cache trail coverage gap detected: role=reference output files must map to verified _cache/ leaf directories. Missing or unmapped cache trails fail coverage; empty cache_trails on a declaration emits a Phase 1 warning.
No wave1-scoped output declaration ledger entries found. Complete delegated relay tasks (dpt-evidence-extractor) through the queue + relay pipeline to populate the output declaration ledger.
Wave1 outputs exist on disk but are not covered by output declaration ledger. Files may have been written directly (bypassing relay). Re-run through delegated relay tasks.
No successful wave1 relay slots found in _subagents/wave_01/. Dispatch and complete relay tasks (dpt-evidence-extractor) through the queue + relay pipeline.
